stem:
Meena finds four objects in her schoolbag: a steel spoon, a plastic ruler, a rubber eraser and a copper key.
She brings a bar magnet near each object, one at a time.
How can Meena decide whether an object is made of a magnetic material?

options.text: The object is magnetic if it looks shiny and hard
The object is magnetic only if the magnet attracts it
The object is magnetic if it is made of any metal
The object is magnetic if the magnet repels it

teacher.key_rationale: A material is classified as magnetic by testing whether a magnet attracts it; only attracted objects (e.g. the steel spoon) are magnetic. Option A (looks hard or shiny), C (any metal — copper is non-magnetic), and D (repulsion) are incorrect decision rules.
